key_idea: A button can be turned but not flipped, so the dots keep the same shape.
steps: The button has 3 dots in a line on the left, and 1 more dot to the right of the bottom dot. The 4 dots make an L.
Turn the button halfway round. The line of 3 moves to the right side, and the extra dot moves to the top, to the left of the top dot.
Button A looks just like that.

choice_feedback.B: This is the button flipped over, not turned. The extra dot is at the bottom.
choice_feedback.C: It has only 3 dots, but the button has 4.
choice_feedback.D: Its 4 dots are in the corners, not in an L.
choice_feedback.E: It has 5 dots, but the button has 4.
